record.question: A Government servant consumes alcohol lawfully in a private setting but later appears intoxicated in a place accessible to the public on payment. Under Rule 22, this is:
options: Not covered because the consumption was private and lawful
Not covered unless he was on official duty
Covered only if he creates disorder or nuisance
Prohibited because he must not appear in a public place in a state of intoxication
